title: Meatballs with Tomato Sauce
description: Meatballs with Tomato Sauce is a classic continental comfort dish featuring tender, juicy beef meatballs gently simmered in a rich, aromatic tomato sauce. Finished with Parmesan and fresh parsley, this restaurant-style recipe pairs perfectly with pasta, mashed potatoes, or crusty artisan bread.

ingredients.title: For the Meatballs
items: 500g ground beef (or a mix of beef and pork for extra flavor)

ingredients.title: For the Tomato Sauce
items: A pinch of sugar (to balance acidity)

instruction.title: 1. Prepare the Meatball Mixture
steps: In a large bowl, combine ground meat, chopped onion, minced garlic, breadcrumbs, Parmesan, egg, parsley, oregano, salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Mix gently but thoroughly until well combined. Avoid overmixing to keep the meatballs tender.

instruction.title: 2. Form the Meatballs
steps: Using your hands or a scoop, shape the mixture into uniform balls, about 1.5 inches in diameter.

instruction.title: 3. Cook the Meatballs
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Brown the meatballs on all sides (about 5–7 minutes). They don’t need to be fully cooked through at this point.

instruction.title: 4. Make the Tomato Sauce
steps: In the same skillet, add a bit more olive oil if needed.
Sauté chopped onion and garlic until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes, basil, salt, pepper, and sugar.

instruction.title: 5. Combine Meatballs and Sauce
steps: Gently place the browned meatballs into the sauce.
Cover and simmer for 10–15 minutes until meatballs are cooked through and tender.

instruction.title: 6. Serve
steps: Garnish with fresh parsley or extra Parmesan.
Serve with pasta, mashed potatoes, or crusty bread.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with freshly cooked pasta for a classic continental meal.
Pair with creamy mashed potatoes for a comforting alternative.
Enjoy with warm crusty artisan bread to soak up the rich tomato sauce.

chefTips: Mix the meat gently to keep the meatballs tender and juicy.
Brown the meatballs well before simmering to develop deep flavor.
Allow the meatballs to finish cooking slowly in the tomato sauce for maximum tenderness.
Finish with freshly grated Parmesan and chopped parsley just before serving for restaurant-quality presentation.
